claim: *Attribution provenance model.* A run contains consequential operations; each operation records its target, mutation, responsible pass, and retained evidence. Audit and explanation can be derived from this shared history.

topology.description: Run contains many operation records; each contains provenance fields; derived views secondary.

bw_encoding: Black outlines and arrows; white nodes; sparse 3–7% gray groups. Every non-solid relation is locally labeled; no distinction depends on color.
redesign: Native semantic redraw; colors replaced by labeled relations and line conventions.
alt: A run contains operation records. Each record contains its target, mutation, responsible pass and retained evidence. Audit, debugging and changelog are secondary views derived from that provenance model. The candidate uses black lines, white backgrounds and sparse gray; meaning does not depend on color.
